title: Citation Hallucination Check
signature: def check_citations(answer, passages, stopwords, tau) -> dict
hints: Split sentences with re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+', answer.strip()). Pull citations with re.findall(r'\[(\d+)\]') before you strip the markers out.
Claim tokens: gc_runtime.tokenize, lowercase, keep only \w+ tokens, drop stopwords, and make it a SET. Do the same to the passage.
Citations are 1-based. [0] is out of range; passages[-1] is not a valid answer to it.
Report every cited source, in order of first appearance, but the sentence is supported if any one of them reaches tau.
